_doc: Generated by auditing the already-built site (this repo predates the harness workflow — there was no brief to ingest). Each entry: { id, status, builders, nota }.
_status: pending | in_progress | done — only ONE feature may be in_progress at a time.
_builders: subset of [front-end-astro, seo-guide-lines]. Sections -> front-end-astro; close each page with seo-guide-lines.

features.source: Tailwind CSS v4 upgrade guide — `bg-gradient-to-*` utilities were renamed to `bg-linear-to-*` (v3 names kept only as a deprecated compatibility alias). Verified in-repo 2026-09-15: src/components/ui/CTABanner.astro:40 still uses `bg-gradient-to-r`; src/components/section/landing/LatestProjects.2.astro:57 was already migrated to `bg-linear-to-t` in a prior change, so that file is out of scope despite the nota.
acceptance: src/components/ui/CTABanner.astro:40 uses `bg-linear-to-r` instead of `bg-gradient-to-r`, with the same direction and color stops (from-salviaGreen to-accentGreen) unchanged.
`grep -rn "bg-gradient-to" src` returns no matches anywhere in the codebase.
pnpm build passes; the CTA banner gradient renders visually identical (spot-check the homepage CTA section).
features.nota: CTABanner.astro uses Tailwind v3 bg-gradient-to-r; migrate to v4 bg-linear-to-r. LatestProjects.2.astro was already migrated separately — confirmed clean on 2026-09-15.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/SKILL.md optimization checklist ("Unique meta title, 50-60 characters") + seo-guide-line.md Meta Title section — `generatePageSEO()` at src/config/seo.ts:292 unconditionally appends ` | ${COMPANY_INFO.name}` even when the caller's `title` already ends with a brand fragment, producing duplicated-brand titles outside the 50-60 char range on src/pages/nosotros.astro:25 (77 chars), politicadeprivacidad.astro:12, terminosycondiciones.astro:11, and 404.astro:9.
acceptance: generatePageSEO() strips any trailing brand fragment from options.title (or callers stop including the brand) before appending COMPANY_INFO.name, so the brand appears exactly once in the final title.
Rendered <title> on /nosotros, /politicadeprivacidad, /terminosycondiciones, and /404 each contain the brand name exactly once and fall within (or close to) 50-60 characters.
pnpm build passes; no other page's title regresses (spot-check homepage and one service page title unchanged).
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/seo-guide-line.md URL Structure section ("canonical must match the exact URL shown in the browser") — src/pages/politicadeprivacidad.astro:6-9,15 sets canonical/breadcrumb path to the non-existent `/politica-de-privacidad` while the real route is `/politicadeprivacidad` (confirmed via Footer.astro:208); src/pages/terminosycondiciones.astro:6-7,14 has the same mismatch (`/terminos-y-condiciones` vs real route `/terminosycondiciones`). Both pages' breadcrumb items also use relative URLs (`/`, `/politica-de-privacidad`) instead of the absolute `${COMPANY_INFO.url}/...` pattern used everywhere else (see contacto.astro:9-10, nosotros.astro:18-19).
acceptance: generatePageSEO({ path: ... }) on both legal pages uses the real route (/politicadeprivacidad, /terminosycondiciones) matching the actual file/URL.
Both pages' breadcrumb schema items use absolute URLs built from COMPANY_INFO.url, consistent with contacto.astro and nosotros.astro.
pnpm build passes; view-source canonical link on both pages matches the URL the page is actually served at.
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/SKILL.md optimization checklist ("Heading hierarchy is logical (H1 → H2 → H3), never skipped") — src/components/section/ourServices/ServiceProblemSection.astro:44 renders an <h2>, then :90 renders `introText` as an <h4> with no intervening <h3>, on a component used by all 3 services in src/config/services.ts.
acceptance:
ServiceProblemSection.astro no longer skips a heading level: the

at line 90 becomes an

if it isn't structurally a heading.
All 3 service pages (diseno-web-estrategico, publicidad-digital, ecommerce) show a clean H1→H2→H3 outline with no skipped levels (verify in built HTML).
pnpm build passes; visual layout/styling of the introText element is unchanged (heading tag change only, not a redesign).
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/seo-guide-line.md Pattern 5 (Contact Page) + Contact Page checklist (visible phone/email links, office hours, map) — src/pages/contacto.astro currently renders only GlobalHero + ContactForm; COMPANY_INFO already has phone/email/address (src/config/seo.ts), but no component on the page renders it as visible tel:/mailto: content, hours, or a map — only the invisible CONTACT_PAGE_SCHEMA JSON-LD and the site-wide Footer.astro carry any of this.
acceptance: contacto.astro renders a visible block with COMPANY_INFO.phone as a tel: link and COMPANY_INFO.email as a mailto: link.
Business hours are visible on the page (source the hours from COMPANY_INFO if a field exists, otherwise flag as a follow-up gap rather than inventing hours).
No new client-facing fact is invented — every value rendered comes from the existing COMPANY_INFO config.
pnpm build passes; NAP on the page matches Footer.astro and CONTACT_PAGE_SCHEMA exactly (no drift).
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15. If COMPANY_INFO has no hours field, this entry's scope narrows to phone/email/map only — confirm at implementation time.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/seo-guide-line.md Content Freshness section (freshness signals must be real, not fabricated) — src/pages/politicadeprivacidad.astro:32 and src/pages/terminosycondiciones.astro:31 render `Última actualización: {new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`, which always shows today's build date rather than the actual last-edit date of the legal text, silently "refreshing" on every rebuild.
acceptance: Both legal pages render a static last-updated date sourced from the actual last content edit (e.g. a frontmatter/const date updated only when the legal text itself changes), not `new Date()` evaluated at build/render time.
The displayed date does not change on a rebuild unless the legal text itself was edited in that same change.
pnpm build passes.
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15. Use git history (`git log --follow -- <file>`) to pick the true last-edit date for the initial value.

features.source: .claude/skills/seo-guide-lines/seo-guide-line.md Content Freshness section ("note last update date" must be visible, not only in schema) — src/pages/blog/[slug].astro:114-118 has the visible "Actualizado: {date}" UI element commented out, even though `modifiedDate` is already correctly wired into generateBlogPostSchema via src/layouts/PostLayout.astro:47 (invisible JSON-LD only).
acceptance: The commented-out "Actualizado" block in blog/[slug].astro is re-enabled and renders modifiedDate visibly on every blog post.
The visible date matches the modifiedDate already used in the post's BlogPosting JSON-LD (no drift between the two).
pnpm build passes; spot-check one blog post's rendered HTML shows the visible updated date.
features.nota: Surfaced by the seo-guide-lines compliance review, 2026-09-15. Does not cover actually refreshing the 4 stale posts' content/modifiedDate (all 124-248 days past the guide's 90-day rule) — that requires real content revisions from the client/writer and isn't a mechanical fix; track separately once updated copy exists.
